name: Tweet Composer
description: Converts typed double dashes to em dashes inside supported X/Twitter post composers.

notes: Maintainer package candidate adapted without behavior changes from the built-in Composer Tools feature.

settings.label: Composer Tools
settings.description: Convert double dashes to em dashes while typing supported X/Twitter posts.

notes: Runs as a lightweight document input listener for supported X/Twitter post composer textboxes.
Dispose removes both input listeners and the document loaded marker.
Listens only to active post composer input events and ignores DMs, search, native inputs, and textareas.
Tweet Composer does not render app-window chrome.

hub.shortDescription: Convert double dashes to em dashes while typing posts.
dataNotes: Reads only the active X/Twitter post composer text immediately around the caret.
Reads only the active X/Twitter post composer text immediately around the caret.
Never posts, uploads, opens a remote service, or transmits composer text.

notes: Preserves the built-in composerTools ID, storage key, lifecycle, X composer scope, and cleanup behavior.
The checked-in replacement policy and explicit first-party replacement acknowledgement remain mandatory.
